why_not_core: This paper focuses on intraoperative broach handle design and force distribution during surgery, not on postoperative stress shielding, micromotion, or implant-bone interface mechanics.

summary_zh.method: 使用不同手柄设计的骨锉在尸体股骨上进行力学测试
summary_zh.result: 手柄设计改变显著影响股骨近端的力分布模式
summary_zh.validation: 尸体股骨力学测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how broach handle design influences force distribution in the femur during total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Mechanical testing was performed on cadaveric femurs using broaches with different handle designs.
summary_en.result: Broach handle design significantly alters the force distribution pattern in the proximal femur.
summary_en.validation: Cadaveric mechanical testing.

title: Multiobjective Optimization Based on Expensive Robotic Experiments under Heteroscedastic Noise
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Science and Engineering, Graduate School of Engineering, Nagoya University, Nagoya, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Ryo Ariizumi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Science and Engineering, Graduate School of Engineering, Nagoya University, Nagoya, Japan

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的异方差噪声下多目标优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: No FEA or biomechanics context; validation on robotic experiments only, not implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵机器人实验中异方差噪声下的多目标优化问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出异方差与同方差GP模型选择方法，构建代理函数并自适应采样。
summary_zh.result: 算法在蛇形机器人步态优化中优于现有方法，平衡了速度和头部稳定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过蛇形机器人实验与现有算法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address multiobjective optimization under heteroscedastic noise in expensive robotic experiments.
summary_en.method: Proposes a model selection between heteroscedastic and homoscedastic Gaussian processes to build surrogate functions and guide sequential sampling.
summary_en.result: The algorithm outperforms an existing multiobjective optimizer in optimizing speed and head stability of a snake robot's sidewinding gait.
summary_en.validation: Validated via robotic experiments on a snake robot and comparison with a baseline algorithm.

title: Bayesian Optimization with Shape Constraints
relevance_to_user: 该方法将形状约束融入贝叶斯优化框架，可迁移至生物力学设计中的约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply to biomechanical implant design, lacks explicit uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP, and uses only simple numerical benchmarks without real engineering FEA validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化通常不对目标函数形状做假设，但实际中常存在形状先验信息。
summary_zh.method: 提出将多种形状约束融入高斯过程代理模型的贝叶斯优化框架。
summary_zh.result: 简单应用表明带形状约束的贝叶斯优化能提升优化效率与结果合理性。
summary_zh.validation: 在超参数调优和决策分析的标准测试问题上进行仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization typically makes minimal assumptions about the objective, yet prior shape knowledge is often available in practice.
summary_en.method: A methodology is proposed to incorporate various shape constraints into the Gaussian process surrogate within the Bayesian optimization framework.
summary_en.result: Simple applications demonstrate that incorporating shape constraints can improve optimization efficiency and solution feasibility.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard benchmark problems from hyperparameter tuning and decision analysis.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on modular neck fracture analysis, not on stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics of the femoral stem.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the failure mechanisms of titanium-alloy modular necks in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Fractographic analysis and finite element simulation were performed on retrieved failed modular necks.
summary_en.result: Fatigue cracks were found to initiate from fretting wear regions at the neck-stem junction.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on rigid musculoskeletal simulation and does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少刚体肌肉骨骼建模中数据不确定性对仿真结果的影响
summary_zh.method: 提出最大一致子集算子融合多源区间数据，并构建基于融合的概率盒表示不确定性
summary_zh.result: 融合算子相关性高，肌肉力峰值偏差达55N和40N，实现了更一致的不确定性量化

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the impact of data uncertainty on simulation outcomes in rigid musculoskeletal modeling.
summary_en.method: Proposed a biggest maximal coherent subsets (BMCS) operator to fuse interval-valued data from multiple sources and developed a fusion-based probability-box (p-box) for uncertainty representation.
summary_en.result: The fusion operator achieved high correlation (R²=0.99) with classical operators, and muscle force variations showed peak deviations of 55N and 40N for rectus femoris.
summary_en.validation: Uncertainty propagation was validated through inverse dynamics and static optimization case studies, comparing correlation coefficients with classical fusion operators.

summary_en.motivation: To develop a probabilistic model updating strategy that uses incomplete modal data without requiring mode matching.
summary_en.method: A hierarchical Bayesian inference framework with adaptive MCMC sampling is employed, and model reduction via an iterated improved reduced system technique avoids mode matching.
summary_en.result: The proposed method successfully updates the model and quantifies uncertainty using only incomplete modal data.
summary_en.validation: The algorithm is validated through an experimental structural dynamics example.

title: A sequential Monte Carlo approach to Thompson sampling for Bayesian optimization
relevance_to_user: 提供贝叶斯优化中采样效率改进方法，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification in the context of implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化中最大值的分布难以解析计算
summary_zh.method: 用顺序蒙特卡洛采样近似高斯过程的最大值分布

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently sample from the posterior distribution of the maximum of a Gaussian process for Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: Proposes a sequential Monte Carlo algorithm to approximate the distribution of the GP maximum, enabling Thompson sampling without optimizing an acquisition function.
summary_en.result: The method achieves competitive cumulative regret on continuous optimization benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks comparing cumulative regret against standard Bayesian optimization methods.

title: Online Optimization with Costly and Noisy Measurements using Random Fourier Expansions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于随机傅里叶展开的在线优化算法，可处理昂贵且有噪声的测量，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks constraint handling, and does not include uncertainty quantification for point predictions.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵且有噪声测量下的在线优化问题
summary_zh.method: 使用随机傅里叶展开构建代理模型并迭代更新
summary_zh.result: 算法在多个应用中比贝叶斯优化更快且性能相当
summary_zh.validation: 通过基准问题和三个实际应用进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize unknown functions under costly and noisy measurements without computational dependence on measurement count.
summary_en.method: Proposes DONE algorithm that maintains a surrogate via random Fourier expansions and updates it with each new measurement.
summary_en.result: DONE achieves comparable or better performance than Bayesian optimization while being significantly faster in benchmark and real-world applications.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a benchmark problem and three applications: optical coherence tomography, optical beam-forming network tuning, and robot arm control.

title: Evaluation of Physical Properties of Titanium Specimen Fabricated by 3D Printing Technique
relevance_to_user: 该论文评估了3D打印钛合金的力学性能，包括疲劳极限，对理解增材制造植入物的机械性能有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on dental implants and does not address hip implant stress shielding, stiffness matching, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估选择性激光烧结钛合金的物理性能，为牙科植入物应用提供依据。
summary_zh.method: 采用YAG激光烧结Ti6Al4V粉末，制备密实和多孔试样，并进行力学测试。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the physical properties of selective laser sintered titanium for potential dental implant applications.
summary_en.method: Ti6Al4V specimens were fabricated via SLS with a YAG laser and subjected to compression and fatigue tests.
summary_en.result: Dense SLS specimens matched machined ones in yield strength and modulus, but had significantly lower fatigue limits.
summary_en.validation: Validation included density measurement, microCT, and mechanical testing under static and cyclic loading.

summary_zh.validation: 通过二维函数、八维钻孔函数和桁架结构算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient computation of failure probabilities in structural reliability analysis using expensive finite-element models.
summary_en.method: A new method combining polynomial-chaos kriging with an active learning algorithm (AK-MCS) and a multipoint enrichment strategy.
summary_en.result: Accurate failure probability and quantile estimates were obtained with approximately 100 original model evaluations across three benchmark examples.

summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量（金相、硬度、拉伸测试）验证模型精度。

summary_en.motivation: To develop predictive models for the physical and mechanical properties of selective laser melted Ti6Al4V as a function of process parameters.

summary_en.result: The predictive models achieved high accuracy in estimating density, hardness, and tensile strength of the manufactured parts.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed using metallographic analysis, hardness testing, and tensile tests on fabricated specimens.

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of training surrogate models for finite element simulations in nanoindentation material characterization.
summary_en.method: A POD-RBF surrogate model is combined with Taguchi design of experiments and ANOVA to identify and eliminate insignificant input parameters, reducing training points.
summary_en.result: ANOVA-based sensitivity analysis effectively reduces training points without significant accuracy loss, and nonlinear RBFs perform better with increasing spatial distance between training points.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on manufacturing irregularities in porous materials but does not link to stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 理想化有限元模型与实验数据差异大，需考虑制造缺陷。
summary_zh.method: 表征三种制造缺陷（支柱直径变化、倾斜、断裂）并纳入梁单元有限元模型。

summary_zh.validation: 与增材制造多孔钛样品的实验数据对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Idealized finite element models often deviate significantly from experimental data for porous materials, necessitating the inclusion of manufacturing irregularities.
summary_en.method: Three types of manufacturing irregularities (strut diameter variation, inclination, and fractured struts) were characterized and incorporated into a beam finite element model of additively manufactured porous titanium.
summary_en.result: The combined model including all three irregularities yielded apparent elastic modulus and yield strength closest to experimental values, with strut inclination and fractured struts having the strongest effects.
summary_en.validation: The model was validated against experimental mechanical testing of porous titanium samples with different structural dimensions.

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of identifying the best alternative in discrete optimization via simulation by leveraging correlated prior beliefs and sampling correlation.
summary_en.method: A sequential knowledge-gradient sampling algorithm is proposed that integrates correlated priors (e.g., discrete Kriging) and common random numbers, using a Bayesian value of information criterion.
summary_en.result: Common random numbers significantly enhance the optimization performance of VOI-based algorithms in combinatorial settings with costly samples.
summary_en.validation: The algorithm is validated on numerical benchmark problems, demonstrating convergence guarantees and practical efficiency.

title: Gaussian Process Morphable Models

summary_en.motivation: Statistical shape models are limited by the span of example data, motivating a more flexible continuous shape representation.
summary_en.method: We propose Gaussian Process Morphable Models (GPMMs) that model shape variations via a Gaussian process, approximated by the leading Karhunen-Loeve expansion using the Nystrom method.
summary_en.result: GPMMs allow combining data-driven and spline-based models, enabling multi-scale and spatially-varying non-rigid registration without changing the fitting algorithm.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on a clinical use case of 3D forearm image segmentation.

summary_en.method: A Bayesian framework combining parametric linear models and non-parametric Gaussian processes is proposed, along with novel diagnostics for separable covariance emulators.

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize expensive black-box functions by leveraging multiple cheaper approximations with unknown biases.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization algorithm that extends the Knowledge Gradient to multiple information sources, selecting samples to maximize expected benefit per unit cost.
summary_en.result: The proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art techniques in both objective value and sampling cost across benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks comparing against existing multi-fidelity optimization methods.

summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate the applicability of the global sensitivity analysis methods.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发能耐受手术植入并促进骨整合的涂层以降低种植体松动风险。
summary_zh.method: 采用弹性蛋白样多肽（ELP）涂层，通过光交联在钛表面制备，模拟手术植入测试其稳定性。
summary_zh.result: 涂层促进细胞黏附、矿化和早期成骨分化，动物实验显示骨接触面积和界面强度增加。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a robust protein coating that withstands surgical implantation and promotes rapid osseointegration to reduce implant loosening risk.
summary_en.method: Engineered elastin-like protein coatings were fabricated on titanium surfaces via photocrosslinking and tested under simulated dental screw and hip stem implantation.
summary_en.result: Coatings enhanced osteoblast adhesion, mineralization, and osteogenic differentiation in vitro, and increased bone-implant contact and interfacial strength in rat femurs and tibiae in vivo.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays with MG63 and hMSCs, and in vivo rat tibia/femur implantation with histology and mechanical push-out tests.

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization struggles with high-dimensional problems, motivating a scalable approach.
summary_en.method: The paper introduces Random EMbedding Bayesian Optimization (REMBO), which embeds the high-dimensional space into a low-dimensional subspace via random linear projections.
summary_en.result: REMBO effectively solves problems with billions of dimensions when the intrinsic dimensionality is low, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on tuning 47 discrete parameters of a mixed integer linear programming solver.

summary_en.motivation: To account for natural variations in biophysical properties when simulating biological tissues, uncertainty quantification is needed to assess their impact on deterministic simulation results.
summary_en.method: A computational structural mechanics capability is developed using Continuous Galerkin and Discontinuous Galerkin discretizations, combined with a hyperelastic formulation for transversely isotropic soft and hard tissues, and the First-Order Second-Moment method for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The proximal femur is simulated and analyzed for failure under both linear and nonlinear material assumptions, with uncertainty in failure analysis quantified due to biophysical property variations.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated through a simulation case of the proximal femur, comparing linear and nonlinear material responses.

summary_en.result: The constructed numerical model achieves three orders of magnitude speedup compared to the original fine-scale model for macroscopic variables.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on a 2D ODE system and a transport-diffusion system, plus a real-world train passenger density flow case, validate the approach.

summary_en.motivation: The study investigates adaptive bone remodeling and stress shielding after implantation of an uncemented tumor prosthesis with hydroxyapatite coating.
summary_en.method: Bone mineral density was measured using dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry in three regions of interest over 12 months in six patients.
summary_en.result: BMD decreased in all regions, with a 14% loss in the proximal hydroxyapatite-coated area, indicating stress shielding-induced remodeling.
summary_en.validation: Prospective clinical follow-up with DXA measurements at multiple time points.

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate Bayesian inversion for PDE-governed inverse problems with nuisance parameters by leveraging reduced-order models.
summary_en.method: Combines reduced basis method with computable a posteriori error bounds and reduction error models to speed up forward solves and quantify approximation errors.
summary_en.result: The approach significantly reduces computational cost while maintaining accurate posterior distributions for identifiable parameters.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on elliptic PDE inverse problems with scalar and field parameters demonstrate the effectiveness of the combined RB-REM framework.

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and accuracy of polynomial chaos expansions for high-dimensional uncertainty quantification by developing a robust sparse basis selection technique.
summary_en.method: An iterative basis selection method based on statistical inference theory is proposed to build sparse polynomial chaos expansions via regression.
summary_en.result: The proposed method yields sparser and more accurate polynomial chaos expansions compared to LARS-based and compressive sampling methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on high-dimensional analytical test functions (Oakley & O'Hagan d=15, Morris d=20) with comparisons using UQLab.

summary_en.result: The proposed method improves efficiency compared to EGRA and AK-MCS across several numerical examples.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple numerical benchmark examples.
